excerpt: Patsnap sells AI patent search and innovation intelligence, including the Eureka AI agents. Published plan prices, funding and alternatives.
content:
Patsnap is an innovation intelligence company. It gives R&D teams, IP lawyers and patent professionals tools to search the world's patents and technical literature, analyse competitors' patent portfolios and spot risks before launching a product. Its site calls it the AI-native platform for global innovation and says it is trusted by more than 15,000 innovators.

The flagship today is Patsnap Eureka, a set of AI agents for tasks such as novelty and prior-art search, freedom-to-operate (FTO) search, design FTO, patent drafting, engineering problem-solving with TRIZ, life-sciences data extraction, materials research and standard-essential patents (SEP), with a desktop app in beta. Alongside it sits an intelligence suite: Analytics and IP Intelligence for patents, Synapse for biopharma intelligence, and Bio and Chemical tools for sequence and chemical-structure search, plus an API and MCP access for developers.

Patsnap was founded in Singapore by Jeffrey Tiong, its chief executive, with early support from the National University of Singapore. In March 2021 it raised a $300 million Series E led by SoftBank Vision Fund 2 and Tencent Investment, with existing investors Sequoia China, Shun Wei Capital and Vertex Ventures. Bloomberg reported that the round valued it at more than $1 billion, making it a unicorn. Patsnap said the money would go into product development and AI.

Unusually for enterprise IP software, Patsnap publishes some prices. Eureka has a free 14-day trial with 10,000 credits and no credit card; Pro plans listed on its pricing page range from $100 to $400 a month depending on the product, with Enterprise and custom plans through sales.

This profile is put together from the company's own pages and published reporting, checked on 15 October 2026. We have not tested the product, and nothing here is paid placement.
